title: How many bytes in UTF-8?
description:
Write `utf8_length(text)`: how many bytes `text` takes in UTF-8, worked out from each character's code point (`ord(ch)`) with the table from the lesson:

| Code point | Bytes |
|---|---|
| below 0x80 | 1 |
| below 0x800 | 2 |
| below 0x10000 | 3 |
| the rest | 4 |

`utf8_length("Hi é 😀")` is 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 4 = 10. Do not use `.encode()`.
hints: Loop over the characters, look at `ord(ch)`, and add 1, 2, 3 or 4 using an `if` / `elif` chain in the order of the table, smallest first.
rules: Work the length out from the code points instead of using `.encode()`.
